critical_blockers.title: Missing Root LICENSE File
critical_blockers.remediation: Commit canonical MIT License naming Forger Digital Solutions.

critical_blockers.title: Cloud Account Deletion Deficit (GDPR Art. 17)
critical_blockers.remediation: Implement DELETE /v1/account route with transactional cascading database purge.

critical_blockers.title: EEA Regional Ban on Gemini Unpaid Tier
critical_blockers.remediation: Implement GeoIP filtering in Cloud Gateway to block EEA requests to Gemini Unpaid tier.

gemini_authentication.pass2_claim: Google deprecated standard API keys; CodeForge must rewrite auth to use Service Account JSON or OAuth2.
gemini_authentication.pass3_finding: CONFIRMED WITH CORRECTION: Legacy unrestricted keys are deprecated, but Google AI Studio automatically issues Auth Keys bound to service accounts that are still string tokens passed via standard Authorization: Bearer headers. Desktop BYOK does not need raw Service Account JSON uploads.

oauth_token_storage.pass2_claim: GitHub OAuth tokens are likely stored unencrypted due to missing safeStorage/keytar evidence.
oauth_token_storage.pass3_finding: COMPLETELY DISPROVED: Desktop never receives GitHub OAuth tokens (server-brokered PKCE); Cloud drops GitHub token immediately after profile fetch; Desktop explicitly uses safeStorage.encryptString (DPAPI/Keychain) for all credentials.

openrouter_terms.pass1_claim: Hosted proxying is barred under Section 7.
openrouter_terms.pass3_finding: CONFIRMED WITH NARROWER SCOPE: Desktop BYOK is clearly permitted. Cloud multi-tenant proxying requires an Enterprise Agreement under Section 7.3/7.4.

gdpr_art17.pass1_claim: GDPR Art 17 applies to all sessions as a P0 blocker.
gdpr_art17.pass3_finding: NARROWED: CodeForge is not a data controller for local SQLite files on user hardware. Cloud PostgreSQL accounts DO trigger Art 17.
